decisionsTitle: The home page, phase 3: a real page at the root, off until the club says yes
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-10**, deciding the redesign plan's decision 3: a real home page at `/ro` and `/en`, reached from the logo — never a menu entry — switchable on and off in «Aspect» → «Pagina principală»; and his standing rule of the same day: component-based, one named Server Component per section with typed props, each drawn on `/admin/design` → «Mostre», everything the club sees a setting. **The owner, 2026-10-11:** «start the homepage now, with empty photo slots and the plan's defaults», behind its own switch, which stays off. Phase 3 of `docs/REDESIGN.md` is three chains: this one (the page, its setting, the hero, the next run and the run sections), the four sections below them (`feat/home-sections`: «Prima dată», «De ce», the photo strip, the numbers) and a third that puts those four into the page. Amends §353 (the root is no longer the proxy's 308), §251 (the front page is the events — while the setting is off), §319 (the round arrow, on the home page's cards only) and §692 (the plan's rows).

**Decision — the setting, «Setări» → «Aspect» → «Pagina principală».** A fourth card beside the tint, the text size and «Aspectul nou», in their shape: two radios, «Lista de alergări» (the default) and «Pagina principală»; the hero's photograph, chosen like every picture in the house (`TeamPhotoField` under its own stem, `hero`: the upload with its quality choice, «Din galerie», the crop box starting at the largest 16∶9); and the hero's two lines, the headline and the line under it, Romanian and English or neither (§352) — an empty pair draws the site's own words from the catalogue (`Home.hero.*`), never the other language's. Save behind the §384 question, the Administrator's alone (`canManageClubSettings`, asserted at the page, the action and the service), audited as `home_page.changed` under its own entity id (by switch, by picture id and whether cropped, and whether the words changed — never the words or a file name), stored as one `platform_settings` row (`homePage`) with no migration (§100). The save reads the picture's key prefix and size from the store and keeps them in the row beside its id, as an event's `cover` carries them (§709), so the public read asks the store nothing; a picture that is not in the store or is a film's poster (§485) is refused, naming «Fotografia de sus». The row's text names the picture, so the orphan sweep and a delete from the pictures page keep it, and the pictures page lists it as used «Pe pagina principală» (`media/references.ts`, the team introduction's rule, §474). A save expires the public cache's settings (§549). With no row, or one this code cannot read, it is off: the root leads to the listing as it always did. Part B adds its sections' settings to the same row; every field this part wrote stays readable, because every new one is optional.

**Decision — the root (amends §353).** `app/[locale]/page.tsx` is a static page (§549: `revalidate` 86400, no `searchParams`), not the proxy's: the proxy cannot read a setting without waking the database on the site's most-visited address, so it now lets `/ro` and `/en` through. The page reads the setting through the public cache. **Off**, it answers `redirect` to the listing: a **307**, not §353's 308, because a browser keeps a permanent redirect for good, and a visitor who had once opened the root would keep landing on the listing after the club switched the page on. Decided in a prerender, the redirect is a real status line with its `Location`, kept by the CDN with the page's lifetime and made again when the setting is saved. Its body is Next's own document for such a redirect (about 66 KB before compression), which a browser never shows: §353's empty body needs a proxy redirect, which needs the setting at the proxy. The query is not carried to the listing — one static answer serves every query; nothing reads one there. `/` is next-intl's again: a 307 to `/ro` (the one-hop retarget of §353 would now skip the home page), so while off a visit to `/` takes two hops. **On**, the root is the home page, canonical to itself in each language with the other as its alternate, and carries the club's `SportsOrganization` block (BR-REQ-052-02 criterion 1: the homepage). The proxy treats `/ro` and `/en` as static answers (`live-twin.ts`'s patterns, `prefetch.ts`'s list gains `/`), so off Vercel the browser is told what Vercel's CDN tells it. **To check after the QA deploy:** `curl -sI` the root twice — a `307` with `Location: …/ro/evenimente` and an `x-vercel-cache: HIT` on the second, then the same `200` page once the setting is on.

**Decision — the logo, the sitemap and the menu (amends §251, §342).** While the setting is on, the header's logo leads to `/` (`LogoLink` takes the address from `SiteHeader`, which reads the setting from the public cache beside the look), and the sitemap lists `/ro` and `/en` at priority 1 and the listing at 0.9. Off, both are what they were: the logo to the listing, no root in the sitemap (a redirecting URL is a defect there), the listing at 1. The menu has no entry for the home page at all (decision 3): «Alergări» stays the listing at its address, the calendar its tab.

**Decision — the sections (part A), each a Server Component with typed props under `src/modules/home/ui/`.** No element-valued prop (§370), colour only from the theme and `brand.ts` tokens (§694), no island: the links are the house's `Link` and `ArrowButtonLink`.

- **`HomePage`** — the one `main`; the hero, the next run, the weekly runs, the special events, in that order; a last good copy says so above the hero (§281).
- **`Hero`** — the page's one `h1` with its last word in the accent (`splitHeadline`: a `span` in `primary`, pink under «Aspectul nou», never a gradient), the line under it, «Vino cu noi» (the next weekly run's page, else the listing — decision 5, the header button's own target) and «Vezi calendarul» as `ArrowButtonLink` pills, and the club's photograph: words first on a phone so the first screen at 320 pixels is the heading and the buttons, side by side from `md`. The photograph is the page's one eager picture, `fetchpriority="high"`, with the ladder's `srcset` for a new `hero` column (`media/ladder.ts`: half the page from `md`, 728 at its widest); every other picture is lazy.
- **`NextRunCard` — «Următoarea alergare».** The soonest date still going ahead of a group run or a race (open question 7's default: the soonest run; the featured flag keeps marking the race on the listing; a hike or a coffee is never «the next run»; none ahead, no card): its cover, the kind's tag over it, the title as the link over the whole card, when, where, the forecast's words at the start from Open-Meteo's condition code (open question 6's default, §402, read with the listing's own `forecastsForEvents`) and the day's sunset at its place («Apus la …», `sun.ts`), and the round arrow.
- **`RunCardGrid`** — the weekly runs and the special events, split by `eventKind` (§709, decision 9), one card per series shown by its next date still going ahead (§113; a series whose every date ahead is cancelled is no card), at most six a section, soonest first; a weekly card says its rhythm («În fiecare marți, la 18:30») and its next date, a special one its date and place. **A carousel without an island:** on a phone a CSS scroll-snap strip that scrolls inside itself, the next card's edge showing; three to a row from `md`. «Vezi toate alergările» to the listing under the special events (and under the weekly runs when there are more than six).
- **The parts:** `HomePicture` (the 16∶9 frame, the crop drawn as the team's photographs draw theirs, §541, or the **empty slot**: the frame with the mountain mark, faint — never a stock or generated picture, decision 6), `RunTag` (the kind's word beside its glyph from the public registry, on `accentTint`/`accentInk` for a weekly run and `kindSpecial`/`kindSpecialInk` for a special event, each with its dark twin, all held at AA by `LOOK_PAIRS`; state never by colour alone), `RoundArrow` (decision 10's default: a 44-pixel round arrow on the home page's cards only, a picture inside the card's one link, `aria-hidden` — amends §319 on this page alone; the listing keeps its text door), `card-sx.ts` (16-pixel radius, one soft shadow, the title's link stretched over the card with the card's focus ring, §486).

**What it costs.** Nothing new is asked of the database: the page reads the listing's own cached upcoming events (`cachedUpcomingEvents`, held to its clock window) under a last-good key of its own, the forecast's cached hour, and the setting the root already read. It is static — made again when the setting is saved, an event is written or ends, at the forecast's hour, and at the latest after a day. The header reads one more cached setting on every page. No new client component, no new dependency, no new font; the glyphs are inline SVG drawn on the server. **Measured** on a production build (2026-10-11, the sample data, no photograph chosen), at 320 pixels with the CPU slowed four times and a 1.6 Mbit/s, 150 ms network: the home page's largest paint 0.96–1.13 s (the line under the heading), the listing's 1.19–1.69 s under the same conditions. The gate's measurement with the club's photograph in the hero is QA's.

**The design page.** «Mostre» gains «Pagina principală · Hero, NextRunCard, RunCardGrid»: the components the root draws, from the sample rows (`design/home-fixtures.ts`, a file of its own beside part B's fixtures), the hero's heading a paragraph there so the design page keeps its one `h1`. The plan's data marks decisions 5, 6 and 10 `decided` by their defaults and phase 3 `building`; `docs/REDESIGN.md` says the same, lists where each part lives (§ Phase 3, part A, as built) and how the club turns it on; `docs/VIBECODING.md` has a row.

**Defaults taken (the owner's «the plan's defaults»):** decisions 5, 6 and 10; open questions 6 and 7; the hero's second button is the calendar; the site's own two lines («Alergăm împreună prin Brașov» / "We run together in Brașov" and one sentence under it, from the listing's own «întotdeauna gratuite»); six cards a section.

**What comes next.** Part B's four sections (`feat/home-sections`) go under the run sections in the order of the plan — «Prima dată», «De ce» and the quote, the photo strip, the numbers band — wired by the third chain into `HomePage` and their settings into the `homePage` row, with the hero's three buttons' targets as settings. Then phase 3's gate: LCP under 2.5 s on a 320-pixel phone, measured on QA with the club's photograph in the hero, and the club's yes on QA.

**Refused.** A menu entry for the home page (decision 3: the logo leads there). A carousel island (CSS scroll snap; nothing runs in the browser). Stock or generated pictures (decision 6: an empty slot until the club chooses a photograph of its own). Invented figures (the numbers band is part B's, typed or computed, BUSINESS.md §7). Keeping §353's 308 while off (browsers keep it for good, so the switch would not be seen). Reading the setting in the proxy (a database wake per root visit, or a second cache to keep in step). Rendering the listing at the root while off (one page at two addresses, §353's own reason). `next/image` for the pictures (the plan's plain `img` with the ladder). An `h1` for the hero on the design page (one per page).

**Verification.** Unit `home/home-page.test.ts` (the sections' rule, the hero's lines, the components from the fixture: one `main`, one `h1`, the empty slots, the kind in words, the arrow inside the one link, the eager hero and the lazy card, no element prop and no colour literal), `i18n/root-redirect.test.ts` (the proxy lets the root through and treats it as static; `/` one hop to `/ro`; the page's temporary redirect, its static config and its canonical), `appearance/site-look-header.test.ts` (the logo's address both ways), `i18n/live-twin.test.ts`, `public-cache/static-public-routes.test.ts` (the root page is static, its links prefetch only static pages), `public-cache/writes-expire-pages.test.ts`, `shared/confirmed-actions.test.ts`, `staff/roles.test.ts`, `notifications/no-hardcoded-values.test.ts` (the title's `{club}` from the constant); integration `appearance/home-page.test.ts` (off with no row, the save, the audit, the picture kept by the sweep and named on the pictures page, every refusal). E2E `home-page.spec.ts` (serial, desktop project: off — 307 from `/ro` and `/en`, `/` to `/ro`, the logo to the listing, no root in the sitemap; on — one `h1`, the pill buttons with their arrows at 44 pixels, the empty slot, the sections, nothing sideways at 320 pixels, the canonical and its alternate, the logo to `/ro`, the root in the sitemap, the English page; on with scripts off), against a production build; `client-words.spec.ts` (its root check moved to `home-page.spec.ts`, which switches the shared setting serially) and `header-nav.spec.ts` against the same build.
changelogLine: - **A home page at the site's root, off until the club switches it on** — «Setări» → «Aspect» → «Pagina principală»: the hero with the club's photograph (an empty place until one is chosen) and two lines in both languages, «Următoarea alergare» with the forecast and the sunset, then the weekly runs and the special events, each card with its cover and its kind; the logo leads to it, the menu does not. Off, the site's address still opens «Alergări». §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given a request to a locale's root (`/ro`, `/en`), when «Pagina principală» is off — the default — then the response is a 307 to that locale's listing, decided by the root's static page rather than the proxy, and the logo links the listing; when it is on, then the root is the home page, canonical to itself with the other locale's root as its alternate, listed in the sitemap at priority 1 (the listing at 0.9), and the logo links it; a request to `/` reaches `/ro` in one redirect. This replaces criterion 9's 308 (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `i18n/root-redirect.test.ts`, `appearance/site-look-header.test.ts`; e2e `home-page.spec.ts`.

Given the home page at 320 pixels, when it renders, then it has one `main` and one `h1`, the hero's two pill buttons and every card's title link are at least 44 pixels tall, the run sections scroll sideways inside themselves with CSS scroll snap and no script, the page never scrolls sideways, and with scripts off it shows the same page (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `home/home-page.test.ts`; e2e `home-page.spec.ts`.

Given «Setări» → «Aspect» → «Pagina principală», when an Administrator saves it, then it is one audited `platform_settings` row — on or off, the hero's photograph as a stored picture of the gallery with its crop (a missing picture or a film's poster refused, the picture kept from the orphan sweep and named on the pictures page), and the hero's two lines Romanian and English or neither, one side alone refused on the empty side's box; an empty pair draws the site's own lines, and no picture draws an empty place, never a stock one; any other role is refused at the action and the service (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: integration `appearance/home-page.test.ts`; unit `staff/roles.test.ts`, `home/home-page.test.ts`.

Given the home page while «Pagina principală» is on, when it renders, then it carries the club's one `SportsOrganization` block with the root's own address (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: e2e `home-page.spec.ts` (the page), unit `i18n/root-redirect.test.ts` (the page's source).

Given `/admin/design` → «Mostre», when it renders, then it draws `Hero`, `NextRunCard` and `RunCardGrid` — the components the site's root renders — from sample rows that name no person, the hero's heading a paragraph so the page keeps its one `h1` (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `home/home-page.test.ts`, `design/design-page.test.ts`.

batchLine: a home page at the site's root behind «Pagina principală», off (phase 3, part A)
